description: This file defines a base repository class for executing SQL queries asynchronously using the asyncpg library. It provides methods for fetching rows, values, executing statements, and converting database records to dictionaries, intended to be subclassed or instantiated for database interactions in a Python project.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A lightweight asynchronous repository class for executing SQL commands with a PostgreSQL database via asyncpg. It manages a database connection pool and provides methods for common database operations.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository by obtaining a database connection pool.

methods.name: Optional[asyncpg.Record] fetchrow(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Executes a query expecting a single row result; uses the connection to fetch one record.

methods.name: List[asyncpg.Record] fetch(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Executes a query expected to return multiple rows; returns a list of records.

methods.name: Any fetchval(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Executes a query expected to return a single value.

methods.name: str execute(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Executes a command that does not return rows, such as INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

methods.name: None executemany(self, query: str, args_seq: Sequence[Sequence[Any]])
methods.description: Executes a query against a sequence of parameter sets, typically for batch inserts or updates.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] record_to_dict(record: Optional[asyncpg.Record])
methods.description: Converts an asyncpg Record to a dictionary; returns None if input is None.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^    async def execute(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> str:$/

ctags.name: executemany
ctags.pattern: /^    async def executemany(self, query: str, args_seq: Sequence[Sequence[Any]]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: fetch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def fetch(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> List[asyncpg.Record]:$/

ctags.name: fetchrow
ctags.pattern: /^    async def fetchrow(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> Optional[asyncpg.Record]:$/

ctags.name: fetchval
ctags.pattern: /^    async def fetchval(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> Any:$/
